title: Waste connection.
officialText:
The waste from an automatic clothes washer shall discharge through an air break into a standpipe in
accordance with Section 802.4 or into a laundry sink. The trap and fixture drain for an automatic clothes washer standpipe shall be a
minimum of 2 inches (51 mm) in diameter. The automatic clothes washer fixture drain shall connect to a branch drain or drainage
stack a minimum of 3 inches (76 mm) in diameter. Automatic clothes washers that discharge by gravity shall be permitted to drain to
a waste receptor or an approved trench drain.
SECTION PC 407
